locator: I q.3 a.5 co.: aliquid est in genere dupliciter. Uno modo, simpliciter et proprie; sicut species, quae sub genere continentur
interpretation: Read the first way of being in a genus (properly, as species contained under a genus) as: what a thing is properly in is a strict genus. The second way, by reduction (as the point is reduced to quantity and blindness to sight), is not formalized; Aquinas denies it of God by a separate argument (God is principle of all esse, not of one genus).
